description: Nichijo set: a Japanese daily-life collection with three full modes. Leave-home proof - five points (gas, locks, water, air conditioner) proven by a real camera photo or an honest manual check, stored with times for replay after you leave. Laundry watch - three machines with end times persisted as timestamps, counting down across sessions and announcing the end. Origami steps - three works, 21 steps, advanced by a nod while both hands are busy, progress persisted. Merged boutique rebuild of CC11 left-home-proof, JP18 coin-laundry and JP19 origami-steps.
name: nichijo-set
